The topic under discussion is 'powers politics'.
The speaker acknowledges the audience for their attention.
The speaker expresses gratitude toward their team.
Trevor Hastings is part of the speaker's team and is described as 'great'.
Idea Robinson is part of the speaker's team and is described as 'even better' than Trevor Hastings.

assumptions.text: The audience values recognition and appreciation from the speaker.
Public acknowledgment strengthens group cohesion and morale.
Audience expects continuity and future engagement from the speaker.
The term 'incredible team' implies shared effort and mutual trust among members.
The use of superlatives ('great', 'even better') reflects genuine esteem rather than rhetorical exaggeration.
The speaker believes that thanking individuals enhances credibility and rapport.
